name: audio_adjust
description: Improve the sound of a video or audio file. normalize brings it to a standard loudness (target_lufs: -14 for YouTube/Spotify, -16 for podcasts (default), -23 for broadcast) with accurate two-pass measurement. Also: volume (+6dB, -3dB, 150%), fade_in/fade_out, denoise (light/medium/strong), highpass (remove rumble below N Hz, e.g. 80) and mono. Video is copied untouched.

input.description: Path of the audio or video file, relative to the workspace.

volume.description: Volume change: +6dB, -3dB, 150% or a multiplier like 1.5.

normalize.description: Normalise loudness to target_lufs with two-pass loudnorm. Default false.

target_lufs.description: Loudness target in LUFS, -40 to -5. Default -16.

fade_in.description: Fade in over this long at the start. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

fade_out.description: Fade out over this long at the end. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

denoise.description: Background noise reduction: none (default), light, medium or strong.

highpass.description: Cut rumble and hum below this frequency in Hz (80 is good for voice).

mono.description: Mix down to mono. Default false.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_adjusted.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
